elements.text:
Reading the interface of
a horror visual novel

When does a helpful interface
become something we distrust?

I examine how horror visual novels redirect the player’s trust in scores, relationships and familiar controls. Project Perfect is my design response: a workplace that teaches the player how to succeed, then makes that success difficult to accept.
lines: I examine how horror visual novels redirect the player’s trust in scores, relationships and familiar
controls. Project Perfect is my design response: a workplace that teaches the player how to succeed,
then makes that success difficult to accept.
